source_snapshot.test_name_items: All HDD NVMe LED Check - Access /Busy
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check if access/busy LED function works normally

1. Insert NVMe SSD into BP slot and check access/busy LED

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. Check system spec define LED function

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Undocumented raw IPMI bytes plus `lsblk` inventory.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: Management result, device list and operator observation.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; retains operator observation but neither creates Access/Busy activity nor proves the raw IPMI command's platform meaning.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds isolated target, bounded I/O, stable bay mapping, hot-plug gate and time-correlated visual proof.

original_test_intent: For every in-scope NVMe HDD bay, insert the approved SSD and verify the platform-defined Access/Busy indicator changes in correlation with controlled I/O to that exact device.
original_method: The operator performs safe per-bay insertion and visually records idle/activity LED behavior; the agent maps serial-to-bay, runs a bounded non-destructive workload on an isolated target, and captures synchronized OS/controller/BMC telemetry.
manual_activity: Physical insertion and visible per-bay LED judgment are core. Automated I/O provides the stimulus and telemetry but cannot attest the physical indicator, making the case MANUAL ONLY.
required_inputs: Dedicated test file/namespace and read/write/size/duration/rate profile
Operator camera/timestamp method and safe recovery
safety_requirements: Never hot-insert without bay-specific support and approval.
Bind I/O to an isolated serial-verified test target; exclude boot, mounted production, protected and unknown storage.
Do not infer Access/Busy from `lsblk` or a raw BMC command; the source requires activity plus physical observation.
Do not send undocumented OEM raw bytes or initialize/format a drive.
Stop on mapping, media, power, thermal or controller anomalies; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Verify each bay/SSD/namespace map and baseline health.
Run the approved bounded workload for one bay at a time and collect precise timestamps/counters.
Correlate telemetry with operator images and confirm final target health.
Produce per-bay Tool Results without claiming the visible state or verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve and perform each SSD insertion.
Observe idle and active LED behavior for every in-scope bay.
Confirm specification conformance and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not suitable: the raw command is undocumented and `lsblk` lists devices but neither generates I/O nor proves LED timing.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use a platform-approved bounded I/O tool and read-only inventory; omit any BMC LED write unless official mapping specifically supports this Access/Busy function.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All-HDD NVMe scope, insertion, Access/Busy observation and 15/8-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: For each declared bay, record an idle/activity/idle video interval synchronized to target-bound I/O and controller counters.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact NVMe backplane, controller/driver and LED wiring.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record workload/inventory tool and controller/backplane/BMC firmware.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform Access/Busy LED truth table and NVMe hot-plug guide.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds the missing real I/O stimulus and all-bay traceability.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Improves semantic coverage; does not replace human observation.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Population, LED timing and safe target.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Telemetry cannot verify physical color, brightness, wiring or bay location.

project_override_considerations: The project defines `all`, workload and duration. Completion must enumerate tested bays and cannot use an unrelated management LED state as an override.
expected_evidence: Population/mapping, SSD identities, hot-plug approvals and LED specification
Per-bay operator insertion and idle/activity/idle video
Per-bay bounded I/O command/result/timestamps and matching controller events
BMC/SEL/OS logs, final health, Tool Result and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently names Access/Busy; the missing stimulus and population are project inputs. DeepSeek's raw command is a flawed review addition, not an authoritative contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The intent is clear and becomes ready once safe targets, population and expected LED behavior are supplied.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects its raw-command/list-only approach as non-equivalent.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its safe workload and physical evidence controls while applying MANUAL ONLY.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Requires every claimed bay to have its own identity, workload and visual evidence.

review_improvement: Ensures the tested stimulus is actual device I/O and that all-HDD coverage is evidenced per bay.
independent_technical_reasoning: Access/Busy is a visible response to device activity. Automation can make activity deterministic, but physical insertion and indicator judgment remain the accepted outcome and require a person.
no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat insertion/workload, choose another device or issue alternate BMC commands after mismatch without owner direction.
